transformer.name: milvus:embeddings
transformer.title: Milvus (Embeddings)
transformer.description: Prepares the message to become an object writable by Milvus component

transformerIn.description: A LangChain4j TextSegment, or a String the converter of camel-langchain4j-embeddings turns into one; the embedding comes from the CamelLangChain4jEmbeddingsVector header, and the CamelMilvusAction header must be INSERT or UPSERT. A null body or no embedding fails

transformerOut.description: An InsertParam for INSERT or an UpsertParam for UPSERT
